title: Capcom: unauthorized access to CAPCOM ID, 11,774,247 email records affected; no password compromise confirmed, no cards

claims.text: 11,774,247 records: email addresses plus account creation, last login, login count, last client IP
43 records also DOB, gender, country/region, nickname
196 accounts had passwords changed without authorization; reset
no compromise of customer-set passwords confirmed; credit card info not included
services available; games unaffected; detected 19 Oct; police and PPC informed 21 Oct
